This is a wiki about the Roblox classic game Ninja Tycoon (formerly '''Naruto Tycoon'''), which is inspired by the franchise Naruto and its sequels: "Naruto Shippuden" and "Boruto: Next Generations". Ninja Tycoon (formerly known as Naruto Tycoon) is a ninja base-building and combat game on Roblox. The goal of the game is to expand your own ninja headquarters, unlock powerful jutsus, and purchase iconic weapons to become the strongest warrior on the server. The more you evolve your tycoon, the more elite skills and equipment you unlock to dominate the battlefield. Ninja Tycoon is developed by '''Coldjason'''. '''Clans:''' Akatsuke, Hyago, Sonju, Uchika, Hotate, Otsutsushi, Uzumonki, Kaseka, and Sarukobi. Cash.text:
Cash is one of the two in-game funds. The other being [[Ryo]]. Cash is earned from droppers, or can be purchased with Robux. Using Cash, you can buy Droppers, Infusers, Decorations, and other items in your tycoon. You can also buy Jutsus and Weapons for Cash. 

== Earning ==

* Generated by ''Droppers''

*Buying for Robux: $10,000 for 30R$, $100,000 for 140R$, and $1,000,000 for 150R$.

== Usage ==

* Can be used to buy: Tycoon Items (Droppers, Walls), Weapons, Jutsus.

Ryo.text:
Ryo is one of the two in-game funds. The other being [[Cash]]. Ryo is collected by killing bosses and other NPC's. Using Ryo, you can buy Ryo-Exclusive modes. Ryo also saves upon leaving. [[File:Ryo.png|thumb|Ryo, one of the two currencies in the game.]]
== Earning == Ryo can be earned by picking up a ''scroll'' dropped by certain bosses. There are 7 types of scrolls: * F-Rank - Dropped by Rogue Ninja and Reanimated Ninja * E-Rank - Dropped by Mizouki (Mizuki) * D-Rank - Dropped by Oroshimaro (Orochimaru) * C-Rank - Dropped by Pain * B-Rank - Dropped by Juubito (Obito) * A-Rank - Dropped by Nadara (Madara) * S-Rank - Dropped by Kaguyai, Jigan, Tenth Beast, Coldjason There is a 10% chance for Ninjas and Bosses (excluding Raid Bosses) to drop a scroll.

Claiming one of the 9 clans is always the first step in starting the game.

- Clan-related interior decoration (characters, structures, etc.)

- An instant health recharger

- A clan-related outfit

- Three clan-exclusive accessories

Missions.text:
== Missions ==
Missions are quests that allow you to collect Cash and Ryo. You are tasked to kill a certain boss or amount of bosses to receive the reward, and they range from E-Rank to S-Rank.

=== List of Bosses ===
[[File:Mizouki.png|left|thumb|Image of Mizouki on the Missions UI page.]]
Mizouki: E-Rank mission that has a 15% chance to drop Cash and an 8% chance to drop Ryo. This boss is based on an enemy in the first show, Naruto, named Mizuki, that attacked Naruto in attempt to steal the Forbidden Scroll from him. His in-game attack is his shuriken that's on his back that regenerates every 6 seconds.

[[File:Oroshimaro.png|left|thumb|An image of Oroshimaro on the Missions UI page.]]
[[File:Pain.png|left|thumb|An image of Pain on the Missions UI page.]]
Oroshimaro: D-Rank mission that has an 18% change to drop Cash and a 10% chance to drop Ryo. This boss is based on Orochimaru, a character that is infamous throughout the entire series, known for attacking the Hidden Leaf Village and killing the Third Hokage, convincing Sasuke to join him and training him, reanimating the Hokage during the Fourth Great Shinobi War, etc. His in-game attack is a summoning jutsu that spawns 3 snakes that fly around and make a hissing sound when the player is hit by one. 

[[File:Juubito.png|left|thumb|An image of Juubito on the Missions UI page.]]
Pain: C-Rank mission that has a 21% chance to drop Cash and a 13% chance to drop Ryo. This boss is based on Pain, a character that is known for destroying the Hidden Leaf Village and causing Naruto to release eight tails for the first time, almost causing the ninth tail to appear, thus weakening the seal the most out of any previous transformation into the Nine-Tails chakra. His in-game attacks are Almighty Push and regular Combat. 
[[File:Nadara.png|left|thumb|An image of Nadara on the Missions UI page. ]]
Juubito: B-rank mission that has a 25% chance to drop Cash and an 18% chance to drop Ryo. This boss is based on Obito Uchiha, a character that is mainly known during the second half of Naruto Shippuden. He declared the start of the Fourth Great Shinobi War and worked alongside Kabuto to fight the ninja with the Reanimation Jutsu, eventually reanimating Madara Uchiha and becoming the jinchuriki of the Ten-Tailed Beast, obtaining the power similar or exactly to the Sage of the Six Paths, the creator of shinobi and jutsu. His in-game attacks are regular Combat, Truth Seeking Orbs, Truth Pillars, Kami Supreme Illusion, and the Sword of Creation. 
[[File:Kaguyai.png|left|thumb|An image of Kaguyai on the Missions UI page.]]
Nadara: A-rank mission that has a 30% chance to drop Cash and a 21% chance to drop Ryo. This boss is based on Madara Uchiha, a shinobi that only one person could beat; the First Hokage, Hashirama Senju. He takes part in the Fourth Great Shinobi War and eventually becomes the Ten-Tailed Beast jinchuriki after extracting it out of Obito. He was eventually defeated after being betrayed by Black Zetsu, getting stabbed in the back. His in-game abilities are regular Combat, Truth Seeking Orbs, Purple Lightning, Limbo, and a trapping jutsu. 


Kaguyai: S-rank mission that has a 37% change of dropping Cash and a 25% chance of dropping Ryo. This boss is based on Kaguya Otsutsuki, the creator of chakra. She ends up being resurrected after absorbing the Ten-Tails chakra, and battles Naruto and Sasuke, who now possess the powers of Ashura and Indra and are given the ability to seal her away. Black Zetsu joins her in the battle to give her ideas on strategies. Her in-game abilities are Colossal Truth Seeking Orb, Thousand Hands, and a homing needle she throws at the player. 


=== Special Missions ===
Special missions are different than regular missions as they give a small chance at dropping modes or items. There is only one Special Mission in the game as of November 14th, 2025. 
[[File:Akatsuke Showdown.png|left|thumb|An image of the Akatsuke Showdown mission on the Missions UI page. ]]
Akatsuke Showdown: SS-rank mission that doesn't drop Cash or Ryo as an ending reward, but has a chance of dropping items such as Yellow Flash, (Yellow Flash of the Leaf) Puppet of Iron Sand, (Sasori's Third Kazekage Puppet) Cursed Scythe, (Hidan's Scythe) etc. Upon joining the mission, you're put into a room where you choose two difficulties; easy or hard. Each cost 50 Ryo to enter, which all the Akatsuki members spawn in. All of them have the abilities shown in the show; Konan uses paper to attack, Pain uses his pull attack, Itachi uses genjutsu, Kakuzu uses all 5 chakra natures, Kisame uses his Samehada, Hidan uses his Scythe, Sasori uses his puppets, and Dedara sends detonating clay birds at you, and Tobi throws kunai at you. Once you kill any of them, they drop Cash scrolls. 

Hard Mode causes their health to be higher and their cooldown to be significantly reduced, causing it to be significantly harder to defeat any member. Though, once one is defeated, they drop Ryo and Cash scrolls instead of only Cash scrolls.
